books.name: Rumpelstiltskin
books.description: La paja se vuelve oro, los favores se vuelven deuda y un nombre verdadero puede matar.

collection.name: Brothers Grimm
collection.description: Collection of tales and characters inspired by the Brothers Grimm.

info.name: La Hija del Molinero
info.ability: When you die, choose a living player and learn their real character.

effects.prompt: Cuando mueres, eliges a un jugador vivo y conoces su personaje real.

info.name: Royal Surveyor
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn how many living players sit between them and the {{team:grimm:oscuro}}.

info.name: Palace Counter
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn how many living players share their team.

info.name: Queen’s Messenger
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether their allegiance is Good, Evil, or Neutral.
info.lore: A figure imagined from the proclamation that carries the royal festival to every house in the land and later announces the trial of the golden slipper. He crosses roads and market squares learning which {{team:grimm:siervo|plural}} protect the kingdom and which voices proclaim a false bride.

cues.body: The Queen’s Messenger chooses a player. Show their registered allegiance.
The Queen’s Messenger chooses a player. Show their registered allegiance.

info.name: El Molinero Fanfarrón
info.ability: Once per game by day, publicly name a player's team. If correct, their next vote counts twice; if wrong, your vote does not count.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, de día, nombras públicamente el equipo de un jugador. Si aciertas, su próximo voto cuenta doble; si fallas, el tuyo no cuenta.

info.name: El Escribano Real
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and one of their public character claims. If they match, you are Excluded until dawn; otherwise the chosen player is Excluded.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador y uno de los personajes que haya declarado públicamente. Si coinciden, quedas Excluido hasta el amanecer; si no, queda Excluido el elegido.

info.name: Royal Nurse
info.ability: Once per game, when a player would die, they become Excluded until the next dawn instead.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, cuando un jugador fuera a morir, en su lugar queda Excluido hasta el amanecer siguiente.

info.name: El Farolero
info.ability: Each night, choose a player; if they are executed the next day, redirect that execution to the Lamplighter.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador; si es ejecutado durante el día siguiente, la ejecución se redirige al Farolero.

info.name: Palace Chaplain
info.ability: Each night, choose a player: they cannot use their ability that night. You do not learn their team.

info.name: Rumpelstiltskin
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and name a tale character. If correct, they die; if wrong, learn their real character.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador y nombras un personaje del cuento. Si aciertas su personaje real, muere; si fallas, conoces cuál es.

info.name: Crossroads Peddler
info.ability: You begin with the Cursed Reliquary. Each night, its living holder keeps it or passes it to another living player; the Storyteller decides whether the new holder lives or dies. The curse ends when its holder dies.

presentation.title: You received the Cursed Reliquary
presentation.description: The curse remains with you while you live.

reliquaryFate.question: What fate does the Reliquary decree?

info.name: El Perro Fiel
info.ability: On the first night, learn who the {{team:grimm:oscuro}} is. If the {{team:grimm:oscuro}} dies, become the new {{team:grimm:oscuro}}.

effects.prompt: En la primera noche sabes quién es el Oscuro. Si el Oscuro muere, te conviertes en el nuevo Oscuro.

info.name: Mill Whisper
info.ability: Each night, if the {{team:grimm:oscuro}} used their ability, learn whom they targeted.

info.name: El Coleccionista
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn their character. You win if alive after discovering a {{team:grimm:oscuro}} and a {{team:grimm:pueblo}} character.

effects.prompt: Cada noche eliges a un jugador y conoces su personaje. Ganas si sobrevives habiendo descubierto al menos un Oscuro y un Pueblo.

info.name: El Rey Codicioso
info.ability: When an execution kills a player, learn their character and gain Gold. You win if alive with two Gold from different teams.

effects.prompt: Cuando una ejecución mata a un jugador, conoces su personaje y obtienes un Oro. Ganas si sobrevives con dos Oros obtenidos de equipos distintos.

info.name: Extended composition
info.ability: Extended Grimm distribution for games with 7 to 15 players.

gameRules.summaryEs: Distribución Grimm extendida para partidas de 7 a 15 jugadores.

text.name: Rumpelstiltskin
text.description: La paja se vuelve oro, los favores se vuelven deuda y un nombre verdadero puede matar.

nightInstructions.opening: Comprueba que todos tienen los ojos cerrados y resuelve el orden nocturno.
nightInstructions.dawn: Retira efectos caducados, anuncia muertes y entrega la información pendiente.

elements.label: Excluido
elements.description: No puede usar su habilidad, despertar, hablar, votar ni nominar durante el plazo indicado.
